title: Closure under identifying input variables
statement: A Boolean function class is closed under identifying input variables if, for all natural numbers $n,m$, every map $\pi$ from the $n$ input coordinates to the $m$ input coordinates, and every function $f$ in the class on $n$ coordinates, the function obtained by identifying inputs according to $\pi$ belongs to the class on $m$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ maps the $n$ input coordinates to the $m$ input coordinates
$f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$f$ belongs to the class at dimension $n$
